The '''Alderaanian faction''' was a faction founded by [[Halle Dray]]. The group loathed the [[House of Organa/Legends|Organa Family]]. At one point the group captured Leia Organa as part of a plan to turn the [[Prince/Legends|princess]] in to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], and in turn be rewarded with a new [[Planet/Legends|planet]] for Alderaanian refugees. However, the Imperials betrayed the faction, where most of the members of the faction was [[Death/Legends|killed]], and led the downfall of the faction.<ref name="Hostage" />
